text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of thirty-five thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, for the
employment of doctors and nurses; the establishment and support of dispensaries; and the establishment and
support of schools in the Mountain Province and its subprovinces; and for other purposes, as follows:
FOR MEDICAL AID.
Subprovince of Ifitgao.
One doctor, at ?1,000 per annum
?500.00
Provided, That this amount or any part thereof may be paid as extra compensation to a doctor of the medical
corps of the Philippine Constabulary, the provisions of Act Numbered One hundred and forty-eight to the
contrary notwithstanding.
